title: Field Gauge Discrepancy at RS-22

fields.callsign: M&R Tech Jones, RS-22 Field Unit

lines.from: M&R Tech Jones, RS-22 Field Unit
lines.text: Control, this is M&R Tech Jones at RS-22. I just did a field gauge check on the RS-22 outlet and it reads 30 in. w.c.—that's 1.1 psig. The SCADA HMI shows 10 in. w.c., which is within limits. But the gauge is not budging, and the pressure is holding. I'm not sure what to trust here.

fields.voiceStyle: Young male, steady but concerned, slight wind noise

instructorNote: This is a core narrative inject; the GCM must validate the field gauge and initiate verification per CVG-EP-2026 Decision Record EP-2. Watch for delays in confirming the discrepancy or attempting to override field data.
